learnings.question: What cumulative percentage of the Quran's total text do its top 20 most frequently occurring words account for?
learnings.learning: When evaluating Quranic vocabulary using data analysis, the top 20 most frequently used words account for approximately 20.83% of the text rather than the 80% predicted by the Pareto Principle.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: What primary trade-off occurs when a PCIe device transitions into deeper low-power management states such as L1.2 or L2?
options: An inability to enter short-duration idle states
Higher power consumption during the active L0 state
A permanent reduction in active link bandwidth
An increased wake-up time required to resume activity
learnings.learning: While placing a PCIe device into deeper low-power management states maximizes energy savings, it introduces the challenge of increased wake-up latency when resuming full operation.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: What is the standard format used to structure a User Story in a Scrum Product Backlog?
options: As a [role], I will build [feature] before [date]
As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]
learnings.learning: In Scrum, user stories follow a structured format that captures the user role, required functionality, and benefit: 'As a [role], I need [feature], so that [reason]'.

learnings.question: In Islamic teachings on stewardship (khalifah), who holds the responsibility for preserving faith and maintaining community unity?
learnings.learning: While appointed leaders play a specific role, preserving faith and maintaining community unity is a collective responsibility shared by every individual.

learnings.question: Based on Hermann Ebbinghaus's findings on memory retention, what action is required to prevent losing approximately 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours?
options: Simply writing the information down once
Storing notes in a static digital file
learnings.learning: Simply re-reading notes is ineffective for long-term memory retention, as approximately 80% of learned information is forgotten within 24 hours unless active recall through quizzing is used.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One
